# Resource fcp_service

Create/Modify/Delete a FCP service resource

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* vserver fcp show
* vserver fcp create
* vserver fcp modify
* vserver fcp start
* vserver fcp stop
* vserver fcp delete
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.6 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netapp-ontap_fcp_service" "example" {
  cx_profile_name = "cluster1"
  svm_name        = "svm1"
  enabled         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `svm_name` (String) FC Protocol SVM name

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) The administrative state of the FC Protocol service. The FC Protocol service can be disabled to block all FC Protocol connectivity to the SVM. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) FC Protocol service SVM UUID

## Import

This resource supports import, which allows you to import an existing FC Protocol service into the state of this resource.
Import requires a unique ID composed of the SVM name and connection profile, separated by a comma.

id = `svm_name`,`cx_profile_name`

### Terraform Import

For example

```shell
terraform import netapp-ontap_fcp_service.example svm1,cluster1
```

!> The terraform import CLI command can only import resources into the state. Importing via the CLI does not generate configuration. If you want to generate the accompanying configuration for imported resources, use the import block instead.

### Terraform Import Block

This requires Terraform 1.5 or higher, and will auto create the configuration for you

First create the block

```terraform
import {
  to = netapp-ontap_fcp_service.example
  id = "svm1,cluster1"
}
```

Next run, this will auto create the configuration for you

```shell
terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf
```
